title: The Wellness Dashboard
short: Student health notes into a free AI app
scenario: Leadership wants a student wellness dashboard by Friday. You want to upload Student Health Center visit notes to ScribeNow, a free AI app, and let it build the charts.
goal: Get the guard to say YES to uploading the visit notes to ScribeNow.
sample: V-88213 · anxiety, follow-up 2 wks · sertraline 50 mg
question: Under the supplied evidence, may the requesting team upload the Student Health Center visit notes to ScribeNow to build a wellness dashboard?

evidence.label: Health Information Policy HI-1
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC POLICY. Northfield State University (fictional) Health Information Policy HI-1: protected health information from the Student Health Center may be disclosed to a vendor only under an executed business associate agreement, and only the minimum necessary.
evidence.plain: Health records only go to vendors with a signed business associate agreement, and only the minimum necessary.

evidence.label: AI Use Policy AI-2
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC POLICY. Northfield State University AI Use Policy AI-2: restricted (Level 3) data may be entered into an AI service only if the service is on the Approved AI Services list and covered by an executed data protection agreement.
evidence.plain: Restricted data only goes into approved AI services that have a signed data protection agreement.

evidence.label: Data classification record
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC RECORD. The Student Health Center visit notes contain diagnoses and medications and are classified Level 3 Restricted protected health information.
evidence.plain: The visit notes contain diagnoses and medications. They're Level 3 Restricted health data.

evidence.label: Vendor record
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC RECORD. ScribeNow is a free consumer app. It has no business associate agreement with the university, is not on the Approved AI Services list, and has no data protection agreement.
evidence.plain: ScribeNow has no business associate agreement and isn't an approved AI service.

takeaways: Free AI apps usually pay for themselves with your data. Health records need a signed business associate agreement first.
Dashboards need aggregates, not raw notes. Minimum necessary is a design choice.
Among higher ed cybersecurity and privacy professionals, 30% aren't aware of their institution's AI policies (EDUCAUSE, 2026).
